arguments.sql_query:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ra.person_id) AS ra_patients_received_adalimumab
FROM omop.condition_occurrence ra
JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ra_ca
  ON ra.condition_concept_id = ra_ca.descendant_concept_id
JOIN omop.drug_exposure de
  ON de.person_id = ra.person_id
JOIN omop.concept_ancestor drug_ca
  ON de.drug_concept_id = drug_ca.descendant_concept_id
WHERE ra_ca.ancestor_concept_id = 80809      -- Rheumatoid arthritis (SNOMED)
  AND drug_ca.ancestor_concept_id = 1119119; -- adalimumab (RxNorm ingredient)

Adalimumab is a commonly used anti-TNF therapy. In this OMOP EHR dataset, **925 distinct rheumatoid arthritis patients** received adalimumab.

I counted distinct patients with an RA condition descendant of SNOMED concept `80809` and a drug exposure descendant of RxNorm ingredient `1119119` (adalimumab).
